description: A JWK Set whose keys member is one JWK object, not an array, fails with InvalidKey; decided by ADR 0054 §4 precedence 1 (ADR 0041 §2): keys must be an array of JWKs (RFC 7517 §5), so the import fails with InvalidKey before any selection; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
